definitions.short: Jehojarib , the name of two Israelites
definitions.full: H3080. Yehoyarib יוֺיָרִיב יְהוֺיָרִיב, proper name, masculine ᵐ5 Ἰωιαρειβ , Ἰωαρειβ , Ἰωαρειμ , etc. ( ׳י pleadeth , or contendeth ) — 1 name of a priestly family ׳יְהוֺ 1Chr 9:10 ; 24:7 = ׳יוֺ Neh 11:10 ; 12:6 , 19 . 2 teacher in Ezra's time Ezra 8:16 . 3 a Judaite Neh 11:5 .
